# Constantino Ferrucci

Senior Generative AI Engineer, contractor at Apple via Tata Consultancy Services
since May 2026. Based in Montevideo, Uruguay. Open to international roles.

Site: https://constantinoferrucci.com.ar/
GitHub: https://github.com/TinoFerrucci
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/constantinoferrucci

## Experience

- Senior Generative AI Engineer, Apple via Tata Consultancy Services (contractor),
  May 2026 - present. Montevideo, Uruguay. GenAI automations for business and IT
  use cases: agent workflows on LangChain, LangGraph and MCP, RAG pipelines over
  vector databases, structured outputs, guardrails, and security and compliance
  controls through rollout and monitoring.
- AI Developer, Wiener lab., Jun 2023 - Apr 2026. Rosario, Argentina. LLM
  assistants for technical support, customer service and product-knowledge
  automation, grounded on internal documentation, technical manuals, PDFs,
  relational databases and search engines. RAG pipelines with vector search,
  metadata filtering and business rules, plus ingestion pipelines for medical and
  technical data and integrations with internal APIs and authentication layers.
- Auxiliar de Primera, Computer Vision, Universidad Nacional de Rosario,
  Oct 2024 - present. Teaches Computer Vision in the Tecnicatura Universitaria en
  Inteligencia Artificial, covering fundamentals and hands-on assignments in
  Python, PyTorch, OpenCV and Hugging Face Transformers.
- Auxiliar de Primera, NLP, Universidad Nacional de Rosario, Oct 2024 - May 2026.
  NLP instruction on the same degree: fundamentals, embeddings, transformers and
  applied language modelling.

## Education

- Licenciatura en Inteligencia Artificial, Universidad Nacional de Rosario,
  2024 - present. In progress.
- Tecnicatura Universitaria en Inteligencia Artificial, Universidad Nacional de
  Rosario, 2022 - 2024. Covers deep learning, computer vision, NLP and industrial

  Rosario, Argentina, 2014 - 2020.

## What I do

- Retrieval and evaluation: hybrid search, metadata filters and re-ranking over
  technical manuals, PDFs and databases, with grounding checks and business-rule
  filters that keep answers tied to verified records.
- Agents, MCP and the backend behind them: tool-calling workflows on LangChain,
  LangGraph and MCP that connect language models to APIs and databases, shipped
  as FastAPI services with Docker for container deployment.
- Computer vision and teaching: similarity search, supervised classification and
  object detection; NDCG@10 evaluation of similarity search; Computer Vision at
  UNR today and NLP previously.

## Flagship projects

- SynergyX-AI - matches a free-text project brief to people with relevant skills
  using embeddings, and explains why each person was selected. Python, FastAPI,
  React, TypeScript, Vite, SQLite. https://github.com/TinoFerrucci/SynergyX-AI
- Datagentra - five-step agent that generates SQL from a plain-English question,
  executes it through a read-only guard that blocks INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE and
  DROP, then summarizes the result and suggests a chart. Runs on OpenAI or local
  Ollama with Docker Compose. https://github.com/TinoFerrucci/Datagentra
- fastapi-fastmcp-autogen - serves the same handler as a REST endpoint and an MCP
  tool in both directions, building Pydantic models dynamically and generating
  Swagger docs. Python, FastAPI, FastMCP, Pydantic, Uvicorn.
  https://github.com/TinoFerrucci/fastapi-fastmcp-autogen
- Dog breed recognition pipeline - three stages (similarity search over pgvector
  embeddings, supervised classification, object detection) behind async FastAPI
  202 jobs, scored with NDCG@10, precision, recall and F1. Written for the
  Computer Vision course at UNR. PyTorch, FastAPI, pgvector, Gradio, Docker.
  https://github.com/TinoFerrucci/tuia-dog-recognition-app
